title: He Heals the Brokenhearted

questions.question: Praise the Lord! For it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant, and a song of praise is what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 147:1 (ESV): "and a song of praise is fitting."

questions.question: The Lord builds up Jerusalem; he gathers the outcasts of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 147:2 (ESV): "he gathers the outcasts of Israel."

questions.question: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 147:3 (ESV): "He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds."

questions.question: He determines the number of the stars; he gives to all of them their what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 147:4 (ESV): "he gives to all of them their names."

questions.question: Great is our Lord, and abundant in power; his understanding is beyond what?
The Lord lifts up the humble; he casts the wicked to the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 147:6 (ESV): "he casts the wicked to the ground."

questions.question: Sing to the Lord with thanksgiving; make melody to our God on the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 147:7 (ESV): "make melody to our God on the lyre!"

questions.question: He covers the heavens with clouds; he prepares rain for the earth; he makes grass grow on the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 147:8 (ESV): "he makes grass grow on the hills."

questions.question: He gives to the beasts their food, and to the young ravens that do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 147:9 (ESV): "and to the young ravens that cry."

questions.question: His delight is not in the strength of the horse, nor his pleasure in the legs of a what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 147:10 (ESV): "nor his pleasure in the legs of a man,"

questions.question: But the Lord takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 147:11 (ESV): "in those who hope in his steadfast love."

questions.question: Praise the Lord, O Jerusalem! Praise your God, O Zion! For he strengthens the bars of your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 147:13 (ESV): "For he strengthens the bars of your gates;"

questions.question: He makes peace in your borders; he fills you with the finest of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 147:14 (ESV): "he fills you with the finest of the wheat."

questions.question: He sends out his command to the earth; his word runs how?
He declares his word to Jacob, his statutes and rules to Israel. He has not dealt thus with any other what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 147:20 (ESV): "He has not dealt thus with any other nation;"

key_verse_text: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
